info.title: ae/game-adapter
info.description: The game adapter realtime-rooms calls (recipe.json connects this port to realtime-rooms' `game` requirement): turn-engine's GameAdapter over the recipe's parts (server/src/parts.ts: holdem-rules, seating, game-clock, private-views, presence, tournament, computer players, round-history, the house rules), whose view answers in the poker wire view the web, Apple and Android clients decode. The application's own `game-adapter` requirement takes turn-engine's adapter, which pokerAdapter wraps. Methods named `GameAdapter.<name>` are members of the object pokerAdapter returns; every one but view is turn-engine's. TypeScript, `implementation/server/src/adapter.ts` (wire.ts, contract.ts).

methods.name: pokerAdapter
methods.description: The adapter: turn-engine's createGameAdapter(parts, engineSettings) with view mapped by toWireView.

methods.name: toWireView
methods.description: The poker wire view from the engine's view: phases renamed, the poker part of the game copied out, the best hand worked out for every face-up hand, the viewer's odds when asked, prompts that name the winner, and the links.

params.name: options
params.description: Defaults to {}; odds true adds the odds rows.

params.name: schema
params.description: The state schema number; only 1 is accepted.

methods.name: GameAdapter.options
methods.description: Per-connection options: one boolean per game-rules optionNames entry; true or "1" switches it on.

methods.name: GameAdapter.members
methods.description: Seated people and computers in seat order.

methods.name: GameAdapter.join
methods.description: A person connects. rejoining: marks them seen and, in a running game, returns them from sitting out. A new person in a lobby sits down; in a game they watch.

methods.name: GameAdapter.parseAction
methods.description: Check a wire action. badRequest for anything malformed. requiresVersion is false and leaves true only for leave.

methods.name: GameAdapter.apply
methods.description: Apply an action. A display may do nothing; a spectator may only leave or cancel.

methods.name: GameAdapter.presence
methods.description: A connection event from the room server.

changed.description: True when someone's connection changed in a way clients should see.

methods.name: GameAdapter.connection
methods.description: A message on one connection: {type: "hold", kind: "look" | "learn" | null}, {type: "hello", hold}, or {type: <option name>, on: boolean}.

methods.name: GameAdapter.advance
methods.description: Run the clocks and presence, everything due, then due computer moves, up to 60 in a row.

methods.name: GameAdapter.nextWake
methods.description: Wall time (epoch milliseconds) at which something next falls due, or null.

methods.name: GameAdapter.view
methods.description: What one viewer sees, in the poker wire view (toWireView over the engine's view); actor null or a display sees what everyone sees. The odds option adds the viewer's odds rows.

now.description: A function now(): number, epoch milliseconds.

Options.description: Option name (game-rules optionNames) to on or off.

move.description: The game's move, from its parseMove.

Schedule.description: When the actor's turn is timed; times are action-clock milliseconds.

seats.description: seating's state, opaque to the engine (JSON).

presence.description: presence's state, opaque to the engine (JSON).

clock.description: game-clock's state, opaque to the engine (JSON).

tournament.description: tournament's state, opaque to the engine (JSON).

computers.description: computer-players's state, opaque to the engine (JSON).

history.description: round-history's state, opaque to the engine (JSON).

carry.description: The game's carry between rounds, or null.

lastResult.description: The last round's result for clients, or null.

game.description: The game's own legal moves for this viewer (game-rules legal).
The game's record for this player as this viewer may see it (private-views).

remainingMs.description: Left on a person's countdown (none of the settle), the next automatic step or the result pause.

game.description: The game's public view for this viewer (game-rules publicView), or null.

lastResult.description: The last round's result, or null.

clock.description: The level schedule's description (tournament clockInfo), or null.

Card.description: Rank 2-9, T, J, Q, K, A then suit c, d, h, s, for example As or Td.

Phase.description: running splits into betting, runout (everyone left is all-in, board being dealt), handOver (result on show) and rebuy (offers pending).

Action.description: What a client sends; parseAction reads it.

auto.description: True when the server acted for an absent or timed-out player.

OddsCard.description: A card of a possible hand, in reading order: a known card (code) from the viewer's hand or the board, or one still to come (from needed, code null) known by rank, suit, both or neither. Spare cards are kickers.

bet.description: Chips in front of the player this street.

cards.description: null entries are face down; the viewer's own cards and shown cards carry the card.

anyOf.description: Best five-card hand once the cards are shown; name is English, category and ranks (0 a two, 12 an ace) let a client build its own text.

potTotal.description: Chips wagered this hand that are not yet in a pot.

remainingMs.description: Milliseconds left on a human actor's clock (with the settle), the next runout card or the result pause; frozen while paused; null for a computer player or a skipped player.

settleMs.description: Settle still to run before the actor's clock starts; null outside betting.

ShowdownView.description: How the main pot was won when cards were shown.

kickers.description: Per hand, how many kickers its shown cards include after the combination.

holdMs.description: How long the result stays up, from the end of the hand.

nextLevelInMs.description: Unpaused milliseconds until the next level.

OddsRow.description: One way the viewer's hand can finish.

probability.description: Chance the needed cards turn up by the river; 1 for the hand already made.

more.description: A row that groups rarer ways and shows no cards.

call.description: Chips to call, or null; may be less than the current bet when the player would be all-in.

anyOf.description: Range for a bet or raise as the street total; max is all-in.

View.description: The poker wire view every client decodes (server/src/contract.ts).

contractVersion.description: CONTRACT_VERSION; changes only when the wire contract changes.

you.description: The viewer's player id; empty for a display.

holds.description: Players holding the play clock; while any hold is on, every countdown stands still.

odds.description: Only when the odds option is on and the viewer holds cards in a live hand.

WireDeps.description: What the wire view needs besides the engine's view: evaluate(cards) the best hand (poker-hand-ranking), shownCards(hole, board, kickers) and oddsRows(hole, board) (poker-odds), and levelDurationMs (level-schedule).

PokerGameAdapter.description: turn-engine's GameAdapter over this recipe's parts with view replaced; its members are the `GameAdapter.<name>` methods.

BadSettings.message: turn-engine: decisionSeconds (1 or more, or null), settleMs (0 or more), staleMinutes, standingsSeconds and lobbyDropSeconds (1 or more) must be whole numbers

DefaultMoveRefused.message: turn-engine: the game's default move was refused: <code>

NoMoveAccepted.message: turn-engine: neither the strategy's move nor the game's default move was accepted for <id>

NoOutcome.message: turn-engine: the game reported the round over without an outcome
